case_facts: I bought a refrigerator that caught fire within a week due to a manufacturing defect, damaging my kitchen. The company refuses to compensate me.

analysis.summary: A consumer purchased a refrigerator that caught fire within one week of purchase due to an alleged manufacturing defect, causing damage to the kitchen. The manufacturer has refused to provide compensation for the defective product and resulting property damage. The consumer seeks redress for the defective goods and consequential losses.

issues.issue: Liability for defective goods causing damage to consumer
issues.governing_law: Consumer Protection Act 2019, Section 2(10) - Defect in Goods

issues.issue: Product liability of manufacturer for harm caused by defective product
issues.governing_law: Consumer Protection Act 2019, Chapter VI - Product Liability, Section 84

issues.issue: Claim for consequential damages to property arising from defective product
issues.kanoon_query: consequential property damage defective product consumer forum

issues.issue: Unfair trade practice and deficiency in service for refusal to compensate
issues.governing_law: Consumer Protection Act 2019, Section 2(47) - Unfair Trade Practice
